# The College Fix

> The College Fix is a student journalism platform covering breaking campus news, higher education policy, and controversial issues affecting colleges and universities.

Founded by the Student Free Press Association, The College Fix publishes investigative reporting and analysis from student journalists across America, covering topics from free speech and curriculum to diversity, politics, and campus culture. The platform serves as both a news source and a launchpad for student media careers.

## Key Topics

- Student Journalism
- College News
- Higher Education
- Free Speech
- Campus Politics
- Diversity & Inclusion
- Academia
- Student Reporters
- Media Careers
- Antisemitism
- LGBTQ Issues
- Curriculum Policy
- Editorial Content
- Featured Stories
- Campus Investigations

## Core Site

- [The College Fix | Breaking Campus News. Launching Media Careers.](https://www.thecollegefix.com): Homepage for The College Fix, student journalism platform covering campus news and higher education issues.
- [About The College Fix | The College Fix](https://www.thecollegefix.com/about): About page describing Student Free Press Association and The College Fix mission.
- [Write For Us | The College Fix](https://www.thecollegefix.com/write-for-us): Submission guidelines and paid journalism opportunities for student writers.
- [Student Reporters | The College Fix](https://www.thecollegefix.com/about/authors): Directory of student reporters and contributors at The College Fix.

## Featured & Editorial Content

- [Category: Featured | The College Fix](https://www.thecollegefix.com/blogs/featured): Featured student-reported articles and exclusive campus journalism coverage.
- [Subject: Opinion/Analysis | The College Fix](https://www.thecollegefix.com/subject/opinion-analysis): Archive of opinion and analysis pieces on campus and higher education topics.
